claims.statement: Taking Gohari--Liu--Nair Theorem 9 as a primary-source premise, the committed official source PDF and its fail-closed, render-complete semantic audit establish that the structured bounded transcription faithfully reproduces the theorem's factorization, equations (19a)-(19p), and both side conditions, and its private-message specialization R0=0 is exactly equivalent to the independently generated local 30-row formulation; the exhaustive single-output term audit proves that input-only product marginalization of G and K preserves this entire system, while the explicit extended-real local definitions (with sup(empty set)=-infinity) give V_Q(G,K) <= V(1/2;G,K) <= B(G,K) and make V_0(g,k) a finite, well-defined function because every Q0-supported row depends on the receiver channels only through (c,g,k,c).
